s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH w/ Skid Control Sensor

s2.ptxt: Install the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH w/ skid control sensor to the rear axle carrier with the 4 bolts.

atten4.ptxt: The skid control sensor and sensor rotor are components of the rear axle hub & bearing assembly. If the skid control sensor or sensor rotor is defective, replace the rear axle hub & bearing assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Axial Play

s2.ptxt: Using a dial indicator, check the bearing axial play near the inner circumference (flange) of the axle hub.

atten3.ptxt: If it exceeds the maximum, replace the bearing with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Runout

s2.ptxt: Secure the rear disc with the hub nuts.
Using a dial indicator, inspect the runout at 10mm inside the outer edge of the rear disc.

atten3.ptxt: If the runout exceeds the limit, change the installation position of the disc relative to the axle hub so that the runout is minimized. If the runout still exceeds the limit after changing the position of the disc relative to the axle hub, machine the disc. If the thickness after machining is less than the disc thickness limit, replace the disc with a new one.

s2.ptxt: ) Align the matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and install the disc.

atten3.ptxt: When replacing the disc, select the installation position where the disc runout is minimal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH to the rear axle carrier with the 2 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3

s2.ptxt: Pass parking brake cable assembly No.3 through the guide of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Securely attach the clip to the guide as shown in the illustration.

s2.ptxt: Connect the cable end to the operating lever of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.
Install the parking brake lever protector to the parking brake cable assembly No.3.
Connect the skid control sensor wire connector.
